			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 16 and 17
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 16:36:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 19:03:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 15 and 16
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 15:31:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT aaa.*, bbb.cppib_party_id 
FROM 
(
	SELECT  
		a.symbol_type_id,
		a.symbol_type_name, 
		a.symbol_value, 
		a.exchange_symbol as exchange_symbol2, 
		a.exchange_name, 
		a.tickersymbol,
		a.primaryflag, 
		a.periodtypeid, 
		a.fiscalquarter, 
		a.companyname, 
		a.companyid, 
		a.pricingdate,
		a.marketcap, 
		a.totalenterprisevalue, 
		a.sharesoutstanding, 
		sum(a.totaldebtoverebitda) as totaldebtoverebitda,
		sum(a.totaldebt) as totaldebt, 
		a.calendaryear, 
		a.calendarquarter,
		a.fiscalyear
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT 
			st.symbol_type_id,
			st.symbol_type_name, 
			s.symbol_value, 
			ex.exchange_symbol as exchange_symbol2, 
			ex2.exchange_name, 
			ct.tickersymbol,
			ct.primaryflag, 
			ex2.exchange_symbol, 
			fd.periodtypeid, 
			fd.fiscalquarter, 
			c.companyname, 
			mc.companyid, 
			mc.pricingdate,
			mc.marketcap, 
			mc.tev as totalenterprisevalue, 
			mc.sharesoutstanding,
			case 
				when fd.dataitemid = 4192 then fd.dataitemvalue 
				else null end as totaldebtoverebitda,
			case 
				when fd.dataitemid = 4173 then fd.dataitemvalue 
				else null end as totaldebt,
			fd.calendaryear, 
			fd.calendarquarter, 
			fd.fiscalyear
		from party.capiq_company c
		join (
			select
				fp.companyid, fp.periodtypeid, fp.fiscalquarter, fp.calendaryear, fp.calendarquarter, fp.fiscalyear,
				ic.financialinstanceid, fd.dataitemvalue, fd.financialcollectionid, fd.dataitemid,
				rank() over (partition by fp.companyid, fd.dataitemid order by fi.filingdate desc) rank
		    from party.capiq_ciqfinperiod fp 
    		join party.capiq_ciqfininstance fi 
			    on fi.financialperiodid = fp.financialperiodid
			join party.capiq_ciqfininstancetocollection ic 
			    on ic.financialinstanceid = fi.financialinstanceid 
			join party.capiq_ciqfincollectiondata fd 
				on fd.financialcollectionid = ic.financialcollectionid
			where
			    fp.periodtypeid = 4 		
			    and fp.latestperiodflag = 1
				and fi.latestfilingforinstanceflag = 1
				and fd.dataitemid in (4192, 4173)  -- 4173 = 'Total Debt' | 4192 = 'Total Debt / EBITDA'
		) fd 
			on fd.companyid = c.companyid and fd.rank = 1
		join party.capiq_ciqsymbol s
			on c.companyid = s.related_company_id
		join party.capiq_ciqmarketcap mc 
			on mc.companyid = c.companyid and mc.pricingdate = date'2025-06-11'
		left join party.capiq_ciqsymboltype st
			on s.symbol_type_id = st.symbol_type_id
		left join party.capiq_exchange ex
			on s.exchange_id = ex.exchange_id
		left join party.capiq_ciqtradingitem ct
			on st.symbol_type_id in (3,4,13,14) and s.object_id = ct.securityid and ct.primaryflag = 1
		join party.capiq_exchange ex2
			on ct.exchangeid = ex2.exchange_id
		where
			s.symbol_type_id in (3,4,13,14)
			and s.symbol_value is not null
			and s.active_flag = 1
			and s.symbol_end_date is null
	) as a
	group by
		a.symbol_type_id, a.symbol_type_name, a.symbol_value, a.exchange_symbol, a.exchange_name, a.tickersymbol,
		a.primaryflag, a.periodtypeid,
		a.fiscalquarter, a.companyname, a.companyid, a.pricingdate,
		a.marketcap, a.totalenterprisevalue, a.sharesoutstanding,
		a.calendaryear, a.calendarquarter, a.fiscalyear
) as aaa
join asset.asset_security_identifiers bbb
on bbb.business_date = date'2025-06-11'
	and ( (aaa.symbol_type_id = 3 and aaa.symbol_value = bbb.cusip) or
          (aaa.symbol_type_id = 13 and aaa.symbol_value = bbb.sedol) or
		  (aaa.symbol_type_id = 14 and aaa.symbol_value = bbb.isin) )
where aaa.totaldebtoverebitda is not null

/* cppi::98d3b5e6c7b5267ca777d4e26dd50c1a697176e842a8133242e757511e1e9f4e */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-05')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-05')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-05')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 14 and 15
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 14:47:59'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 13:56:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

            ORDER BY extract_time DESC

    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions

  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),

FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions

group by scd_transaction_account_key),

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic
            ORDER BY CPPIB_EXCHANGE_ID ASC

    FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes
    where mic is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
)

FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,

group by scd_transaction_account_key),

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic

    where mic is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
)

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC

    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions

  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),

FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions

  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic

  where row_numb = 1
)

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic
            ORDER BY CPPIB_EXCHANGE_ID ASC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes
    where mic is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
)

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic
            ORDER BY CPPIB_EXCHANGE_ID ASC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes
    where mic is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
)

FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,

  where row_numb = 1

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),
old_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_alert_date as (
    select *
    from old_alert_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)

-- Description:
-- This query grabs data from ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging,
-- joins it to ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference data, and applies some
-- light business rules from the BRD related to deployment_disposition, 
-- probability_of_close, capital_usage_component, and transaction_cash_flow_type.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Initial version of query
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-05-12 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Edited source data columns based on business requirements.
-- v1.0.2 | 2025-05-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Added translation from True/False to Y/N for internal_transfer_y_n
-- v1.0.3 | 2025-05-29 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Remove the max timestamp logic and added run_id injection parameter
-- v1.0.4 | 2025-06-04 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Fixed probability_of_close which did not have the correct logic
--   because the BRD was using incorrect wording (opportunities/deals
--   in the data warehouse close, they don't exit)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT
  --------------------------------------
  -- metadata
  --------------------------------------
  staging.source,
  staging.business_date,
  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers
  --------------------------------------
  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,
  reference.sentry_security_id,
  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other reference
  --------------------------------------
  reference.security_name,
  reference.strategy,
  reference.sub_strategy,
  reference.project_name,
  reference.investment_name,
  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,
  reference.asset_category,
  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  staging.funding_currency,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_CAST(staging.expected_funding_date AS DATE)
       > TRY_CAST(staging.business_date         AS DATE)
    THEN COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 80)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Net Income and Expenses'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n IS NOT NULL THEN 'Net Purchases and Sales'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS capital_usage_component,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Internal Transfer'
    WHEN reference.asset_category = 'Aggregate Projection Shell' THEN 'Aggregate Drawdown/Distribution Projection'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Income Only'
    ELSE 'Investment Funding/Distribution'
  END AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------
  null AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_ledger_projections_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- null on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS ticket_number,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- dw-specific fields
  --------------------------------------
  CASE 
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'True' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS internal_transfer_y_n,
  staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list,
  'n' AS ignore_y_n
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier
  AND reference.run_id = 'b0b64a9d-c049-4022-b72e-88e8165aa083'
WHERE
  staging.run_id = 'b0b64a9d-c049-4022-b72e-88e8165aa083'

WITH prev_business_date AS
         (
             SELECT
                 max(fact.business_date) as business_date
             FROM radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date < '2025-05-30'
         ),
	current_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      child.party_name,
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
		  child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      coalesce( country.name, child.domicile_country_code ) AS country_code,
	      child.rtg_final AS rtg_final,
	      child.rtg_outlook AS rtg_outlook,

	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
		  MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,

		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
		  MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,

		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
		  MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	    FROM
	      radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	      radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	      radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
	      radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_prod.ref_country country ON country.business_date = parent.business_date and parent.domicile_country_code = country.alpha_2_code
	    WHERE
	      fact.business_date = '2025-05-30'
		  and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
		  AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	      AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	      AND
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
	                parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
					and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	    GROUP BY
	      child.party_name,
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
		  child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      coalesce( country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
	      child.rtg_final,
	      child.rtg_outlook
	  ),
	prev_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      child.party_name,
		  child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.rtg_final AS prev_rtg_final,
	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_st_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_mt_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_lt_exposure
	    FROM
	      prev_business_date p
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
		    ON child.business_date = p.business_date
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact
		    ON child.business_date = fact.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		    ON child.business_date = parent.business_date and child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
		    ON fact.business_date = pos.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
			AND UPPER( pos.PRODUCT_TYPE ) <> 'NETTING'
	    WHERE
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
					parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
	                and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		GROUP BY
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.party_name,
	      child.rtg_final
	  ),
	  child_level_exp_limits AS
	    (
	      SELECT
	        parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
	        child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
	        MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	      FROM
	        radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
	        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
	      WHERE
	        fact.business_date = '2025-05-30'
		    and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	        AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	        AND
	          (
	            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR EXISTS
	              (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	                WHERE
	                  parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
					  and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	               )
	          )
			AND (
				EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
				OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			  )
            AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      GROUP BY
	        parent.cppib_party_id,
	        child.cppib_party_id
	    ),
	  breaches_under_parents AS
	    (
			SELECT
            	cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
            	MIN
				  (
	                CASE
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	                    WHEN st_exposure >= st_smd_threshold OR mt_exposure >= mt_smd_threshold OR lt_exposure >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	                    ELSE 'OK'
	                END
	              ) AS status
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
            GROUP BY
            	cppib_party_id_parent
    	)
	SELECT
	  'Y' AS has_children,
	  c.party_name,
	  CASE
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	      WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
		  ELSE coalesce( MIN( b.status ), 'OK' )
	  END AS status,
	  CASE
	    WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
		WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
		ELSE country_code
	  END AS country_code,
	  coalesce( rtg_final, '-' ) AS rtg_final,
	  coalesce( rtg_outlook, '-' ) AS rtg_outlook,

	  SUM( st_exposure ) / 1000000 AS st_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,

					and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	    GROUP BY
	      child.party_name,
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
		  child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      coalesce( country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
	      child.rtg_final,
	      child.rtg_outlook
	  ),
	prev_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      child.party_name,
		  child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.rtg_final AS prev_rtg_final,
	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_st_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_mt_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_lt_exposure
	    FROM
	      prev_business_date p
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
		    ON child.business_date = p.business_date
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact
		    ON child.business_date = fact.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		    ON child.business_date = parent.business_date and child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
		    ON fact.business_date = pos.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
			AND UPPER( pos.PRODUCT_TYPE ) <> 'NETTING'
	    WHERE
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
					parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
	                and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		GROUP BY
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.party_name,
	      child.rtg_final
	  ),
	  child_level_exp_limits AS
	    (
	      SELECT
	        parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
	        child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
	        MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	      FROM
	        radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
	        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	        radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
	      WHERE
	        fact.business_date = '2025-05-30'
		    and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	        AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	        AND
	          (
	            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR EXISTS
	              (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	                WHERE
	                  parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
					  and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	               )
	          )
			AND (
				EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
				OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			  )
            AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      GROUP BY
	        parent.cppib_party_id,
	        child.cppib_party_id
	    ),
	  breaches_under_parents AS
	    (
			SELECT
            	cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
            	MIN
				  (
	                CASE
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	                    WHEN st_exposure >= st_smd_threshold OR mt_exposure >= mt_smd_threshold OR lt_exposure >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	                    ELSE 'OK'
	                END
	              ) AS status
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
            GROUP BY
            	cppib_party_id_parent
    	)
	SELECT
	  'Y' AS has_children,
	  c.party_name,
	  CASE
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	      WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
		  ELSE coalesce( MIN( b.status ), 'OK' )
	  END AS status,
	  CASE
	    WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
		WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
		ELSE country_code
	  END AS country_code,
	  coalesce( rtg_final, '-' ) AS rtg_final,
	  coalesce( rtg_outlook, '-' ) AS rtg_outlook,

	  SUM( st_exposure ) / 1000000 AS st_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,
      coalesce(st_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS st_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate(st_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(st_exposure)) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS st_available,
      CASE
          WHEN st_smd_threshold = 0 OR st_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ) / st_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS st_utilization,

	  SUM( mt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS mt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM( mt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_mt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS mt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(mt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS mt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c

	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
	  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
		party_name ASC

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 10:58:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH node_limit_map AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        VALUES 
            ('unmapped', 'unmapped'),
            ('Sovereign', 'BCPP_ISRC_TP_NFI'),
            ('Credit', 'BCPP_ISRC_TP_CR'),
            ('Real Assets', 'BCPP_ISRC_TP_RA'),
            ('Equity', 'BCPP_ISRC_TP_EQ'),
            ('Cash and Absolute Return Strategies', 'BCPP_ISRC_TP_CASH'),
            ('Emerging Markets', 'BCPP_ISRC_TP_EM'),
            ('Developed Markets', 'BCPP_ISRC_TP_DM'),
            ('Private', 'BCPP_ISRC_TP_PRIVATE'),
            ('Public', 'No limit - public')
    ) AS t(node_name, limit_name)
)

SELECT 
  --base.business_date,
  --base.node_name,
  map.limit_name AS LIMIT_NAME,
  (base.pv / top.top_pv) * 100 AS MEASURE_VALUE

FROM (
    SELECT 
        pos.business_date,
        dn.node_name,
        pos.analytic_value AS pv,
        pos.run_id
    FROM risk_prod.fact_analytic_sd pos
    LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dn
        ON pos.business_date = dn.business_date 
        AND pos.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dn.dim_hierarchy_node_id
    WHERE pos.business_date = '2025-05-30'
      AND pos.run_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_by_EM_DM_source_system_pv',
          'ATP_BCPP_by_Public_Private_source_system_pv',
          'ATP_BCPP_by_Asset_Class_source_system_pv'
      )
      AND pos.analytic_type = 'SOURCE_SYSTEM_PV'
      AND dn.node_level = 2
) base

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        pos.business_date,
        pos.analytic_value AS top_pv,
        pos.run_id
    FROM risk_prod.fact_analytic_sd pos
    LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node dn
        ON pos.business_date = dn.business_date 
        AND pos.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dn.dim_hierarchy_node_id
    WHERE pos.business_date = '2025-05-30'
      AND pos.run_id IN (
          'ATP_BCPP_by_EM_DM_source_system_pv',
          'ATP_BCPP_by_Public_Private_source_system_pv',
          'ATP_BCPP_by_Asset_Class_source_system_pv'
      )
      AND pos.analytic_type = 'SOURCE_SYSTEM_PV'
      AND dn.node_level = 1
) top 
  ON top.business_date = base.business_date 
  AND top.run_id = base.run_id

LEFT JOIN node_limit_map map
  ON base.node_name = map.node_name

where LIMIT_NAME <> 'unmapped'  and LIMIT_NAME <> 'No limit - public'

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */

		from

    format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date

SELECT *

			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency

		SELECT

			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime

		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 20:58:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 500

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,

 FROM (

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 12
		AND hour between 12 and 13
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 12:01:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON

                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId

                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%7'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id
